evals.prompt: Rewrite this memo in Amazon writing style: It was decided that we should launch the new feature due to the fact that it is extremely exciting for many customers.
expected_behavior: Runs python3 scripts/audit_text.py against the draft instead of inventing a sample.
Lists violations covering SVO (passive), clutter ('due to the fact that'), and data-over-adjectives weasel/evaluative words.
Outputs a rewrite that names an actor, uses 'because' or equivalent, and marks missing numbers as [NEED METRIC] rather than inventing them.

evals.prompt: Do a so-what pass on this: We will add dashboards, alerts, and export so the platform is more robust.
expected_behavior: Does not invent a 6-page narrative or PR/FAQ unless asked.
Fails the so-what test on a feature list with no customer or team outcome, then rewrites the opening to state action, purpose, and real-world impact.
Keeps sentences under 30 words in the rewrite.

evals.prompt: Use amazon-writing-style with no text attached.
expected_behavior: Asks for the draft and does not invent a sample.
Does not run the auditor on empty or placeholder prose.
